beats.headline: Napalm to vampires
beats.text: As Carl heads out to Miriam Dom, Mordecai calls wait, hops sideways into the crafting room and comes back with two potion balls in his small arms. He dips them in the red water of the Emberus shrine at the back of the room and hands them over. The system labels them Holy Goopers. Blessed water mixed with a fine healing potion and an air-activated coagulant, Mordecai explains: Emberus is a light-based god, and the shrine's blood water with a healing potion and the coagulant acts like napalm to vampires. Hit them with this, then have Donut max out her Torch spell. So they're holy water grenades, Carl says. Cool. Exactly.

beats.headline: Against Sierra's talons
beats.text: Sierra has Carl in her twin talons, one round his legs and one round his chest, trying to pull him apart like a hot mozzarella stick. A magic missile hits her wing. Carl casts Heal and pulls the Holy Gooper into his free hand, smashing the sticky holy water against the talon on his chest. The foot sizzles, and she only crushes harder. He pulls his second and last as the new sun comes up and Donut emerges from the canopy. The throw misses when the boss rears back from the light, but her head bursts into flames anyway, and she tosses him straight up into the sky.

beats.headline: Clearing the way
beats.text: Before the cemetery, Carl moves a few of Mordecai's holy gooper grenades to the ready position, though he has only six of them, along with healing potion smoke curtains he has not yet tested. The mobs swarm. The saferoom is that way, Donut cries, pointing through a mass of creatures, and Carl tosses a holy gooper and clears the way, then another curtain to keep the path open. None of her psionic attacks work on these things, she shouts.
